title: Design System
problem: After establishing the bank's brand identity and foundational components, the challenge was to make the system clear, scalable, and easy for designers and developers to implement.
overview: A complete design system for a bank, built to manage product design at scale through reusable components and patterns.
role: Collaborated with designers and developers to create a standardized component library.
Designed platform assets from zero to one, using an agile process to iterate continuously.
Worked with Figma, FigJam, Google Docs, Google Meet, and Slack.

sections.title: The project

blocks.heading: The goal — Build a design system that will:

list: Create a consistent visual language across products and platforms.
Document reusable components and patterns so designers and developers can work from a shared source of truth.
Support accessible, scalable product delivery without sacrificing brand consistency.

blocks: The system improves efficiency, user experience, scalability, and brand consistency. It provides a solid foundation for creating and maintaining high-quality, user-centered products while strengthening collaboration across the organization.

This project reinforced the importance of consistency in building a strong brand and a seamless user experience. Clear standards help designers and developers collaborate, while adaptable components make the system easier to evolve. Documentation, governance, and user feedback are as important as the components themselves.

sections.title: Design Process
blocks: In this project, I began by understanding the brand identity and user needs, collaborating closely with the team to define standardized frameworks. Through iterative design, we ensured the system's comprehensibility and anticipated future updates. I balanced creativity with brand guidelines, crafting cohesive design components across platforms. We documented progress and gathered user feedback to refine the system continuously. This approach enabled us to create captivating product experiences meeting user needs effectively.

list: Provide clear and visible focus styles for interactive elements, allowing keyboard users to see which element they are currently focused on.
Include descriptive alt text for all images to provide context for users who rely on screen readers.
Ensure form fields are properly labeled and provide helpful error messages for users who may have difficulty completing forms.
Design layouts that accommodate resizable text to ensure readability for users who may need to increase font sizes.
Adoption and Documentation: Ensure that the design system is widely adopted by all relevant teams and stakeholders.
Governance and Maintenance: Establish a governance model to oversee the maintenance and evolution of the design system.

Cross-Team Collaboration: Foster a culture of sharing insights, best practices, and learnings to continuously improve the design system and ensure its effective implementation across different projects and products.
